goal: Implement domain-check: a CLI that reports whether domains are registered or available via RDAP with DNS fallback, with bulk input, purchase links for available domains, TLD coverage reporting, and schema-conformant JSON output.
done_when: All units U1-U10 have status=done and checks/verify.sh --all --live passes twice consecutively (two full green runs back-to-back). Ledger-selected verification is per-iteration feedback only and can never satisfy done_when.

rules: Pick the first pending unit whose dependencies are all done; set it in_progress.
Only touch files listed in the unit's allowed_paths (plus this ledger). manifest_guard.py enforces this.
A unit is done only when its own acceptance command passes AND ledger-selected checks/verify.sh shows no regression in previously-done units.
Never edit files under tests/, tests_live/, checks/, or schema/ during loop iterations — the baseline gate is immutable except via a human-approved amendment logged below.
On acceptance failure, increment attempts; at max_attempts mark the unit failed and halt.

changes: schema/results.schema.json: optional purchase_url (string, uri format) on result rows, required whenever verdict is 'available'

added U9 purchase-link builder: registrar search URL per available domain; primary Porkbun, fallback Namecheap, recorded in README; offline tests in tests/test_u9_purchase.py plus live probe (HTTP <400, body echoes domain) in tests_live/test_live_purchase.py

added U10 --coverage report: >=1000 resolvable TLD endpoints from the cached IANA bootstrap asserted live in tests_live/test_live_coverage.py; unresolvable TLDs listed by name, never hidden; offline contract in tests/test_u10_coverage.py

tests/test_u5_verdict.py: invariant that DNS evidence alone can never produce verdict 'available'; DNS only raises/lowers confidence or confirms 'registered'; RDAP absence with no other authority is 'unknown'
done_when: all units done AND checks/verify.sh --live passes twice consecutively
tests/test_u7_output.py: available example row carries purchase_url per the amended schema

amendments.reason: verify.sh full-suite step 5 could not exit 0 until all units existed (collection errors on missing modules), making per-unit acceptance from its exit code impossible; approved as A2 with two modifications
changes: checks/verify.sh step 5 is ledger-selected: runs acceptance tests of units with status done or in_progress; selection is monotonic (tests of done units always included)
checks/verify.sh gains an --all flag running the full offline suite regardless of ledger status; --all and --live compose
done_when now requires checks/verify.sh --all --live to pass twice consecutively; ledger-selected verification is per-iteration feedback only and can never satisfy done_when
per-unit protocol corrected: a unit is done when its own acceptance command passes AND ledger-selected verify.sh shows no regression in previously-done units
confirmed the 10-unit ledger governs over the loop prompt's earlier '8 units' wording

units.title: CLI skeleton: argument parsing, usage, version, exit codes
Domain validation and normalization (case, trailing dot, IDN/punycode)
RDAP client: IANA bootstrap, lookup, status classification
DNS fallback probe (NS lookup, NXDOMAIN handling)
Verdict engine combining RDAP and DNS signals with confidence
Bulk mode: many domains, order-preserving, per-domain error isolation
JSON results output conforming to schema/results.schema.json, wired into the CLI
Packaging and docs: console entry point, README usage
Purchase-link builder: registrar search URL for every available domain (primary Porkbun, fallback Namecheap)
--coverage report: resolvable vs unresolvable TLDs from the cached IANA bootstrap, unresolvable listed by name

stall.on_stall: Halt the loop, mark the unit failed, and surface the diff plus failing test output for human review.

cost_envelope.notes: One unit per iteration; the verify gate must pass for a unit before it is marked done. Iteration cap raised from 24 to 30 with amendment A1 (two extra units plus the double live-pass done gate).

provenance: Baseline authored best-effort in a cloud session without access to the original LOOP-domaincheck.md spec (local file was unreachable); scope confirmed with the user as an availability-checker CLI. Amendment A1 reconciles the baseline against the spec's requirements as relayed and approved by the user.
